description: Keeps address-bar suggestions inside the active Zen space's container.

conflicts.description: Groups of two or more spaces in the same container (container 0 for spaces without one), which the add-on cannot tell apart.

canRetry.description: Whether switching the add-on on runs the checks again. False after a failure while it was loading, which only a Zen restart retries.

functions.name: start
functions.description: Loads the container index, hooks the address bar, runs the self-check, turns the history-based suggestions on if it passed, and resolves to the status. Calling it again returns the same start.

functions.name: getStatus
functions.description: The current status, once start-up is over.

functions.name: setEnabled
functions.description: Turns scoping and the history-based suggestions on or off and resolves to the new status. On runs the self-check again, also after a failed check.

functions.name: setDebug
functions.description: Turns the debug log of every address-bar decision on or off. Off also empties the log.

functions.name: getLog
functions.description: The debug log lines and errors, oldest first.
